summary: Add comprehensive acceptance tests for category renaming, decimal mileage validation, UI layout changes on the Dashboard, Receipt Entry, and Settings screens.
steps: 1. Update src/lib/categories.ts: In renameCategory, after successful validation and name change, query the receipt store for all receipts with a category matching the old name (case‑insensitive) and update each receipt's category to the new name, preserving all other fields. Ensure the rename operation is atomic: if validation fails, abort without touching receipts.
2. Ensure src/lib/categories.ts exports a helper isCategoryInUse that now checks the updated receipts (new name) and returns true when any receipt uses the given name.

3. In src/lib/mileage.ts, adjust validateMileageMiles to accept numbers > 0 with at most one decimal place. Use a regex or numeric check to enforce the rule, returning appropriate error messages for invalid inputs (must be > 0, must be ≤ 10,000, must have at most one decimal place). Ensure calculateMileageDeduction works with decimal miles (no change needed).

4. Update the Add mileage UI (src/screens/MileageEntryScreen.tsx) to bind the Miles TextInput to a string, allow decimal entry, and use the updated validator. Ensure the displayed deduction uses the decimal value (already handled by calculateMileageDeduction).

5. Modify src/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx: move the FAB add buttons and the Receipt saved Snackbar so they render above the Recent activity FlatList, adjust z‑index or positioning as needed, and ensure each activity row displays its amount (e.g., render <Text>{item.amount}</Text>). Add style tweaks to make the bottom tab bar fully visible on a 390x844 screen (adjust padding/margin).

6. Adjust src/screens/ReceiptEntryScreen.tsx: ensure the screen title appears only in the header (remove any duplicate title component), place the date picker icon inside the Date TextInput (use InputAdornment), remove any oversized gaps between fields (use standard spacing constants), and conditionally render the "Scan receipt" button only when OCR scanning is supported (check isSupported from expo-text-extractor).

7. Refactor src/screens/SettingsScreen.tsx: replace the separate App lock button with a switch row only, convert the other entries (Tax settings, Categories, Export, Backup & restore, Delete all data, View Terms & Privacy Policy) to ListItem components with a chevron, style Delete all data with the error color, place it as the last item separated by a divider.
8. Add Jest unit tests for the new logic:

- __tests__/categoriesRename.test.ts verifies that renaming a category updates receipts case‑insensitively, that getAllCategories no longer lists the old name, that syncCategoriesWithReceipts does not re‑add it, and that isCategoryInUse(newName) returns true. Also test that a failing rename leaves receipts untouched.

- __tests__/mileageDecimal.test.ts checks that validateMileageMiles accepts 12.5, rejects 0, negative, 12.55 and non‑numeric strings, and that adding a mileage entry with "12.5" stores the decimal miles and the deduction uses the decimal value.
9. Add React Native component tests using @testing-library/react-native:

- __tests__/dashboardLayout.test.ts renders DashboardScreen and asserts that the FAB buttons are present above the FlatList, that each activity row contains an amount Text element, and that the bottom tab labels are all visible (check for presence of label texts).

- __tests__/receiptEntryLayout.test.ts renders ReceiptEntryScreen and asserts the single header title, the date picker icon inside the date field, no large gaps (by checking that consecutive fields have the standard spacing style), and that the Scan receipt button is only rendered when the mock expo-text-extractor.isSupported is true.

- __tests__/settingsLayout.test.ts renders SettingsScreen and asserts the existence of a single App lock switch row, that list rows for other entries have a chevron, that Delete all data row uses the error color and appears last after a divider.

10. Ensure all new tests import from the correct modules (e.g., import { renameCategory, getAllCategories, syncCategoriesWithReceipts, isCategoryInUse } from '../../src/lib/categories'), and that mock stores are created using the in‑memory store utilities (createStore, createMemoryRawStore, createMemoryKeyProvider).
11. Run npm test to verify all existing tests still pass and the new tests succeed.
12. No changes to package.json or other build configuration are required; the added tests will be discovered automatically by the existing Jest configuration.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Runs the app's acceptance tests: the Jest files in __tests__/acceptance/. Generated by the pipeline; the tests
themselves are locked files written by the planner. ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE=N runs only the tests of milestones 1..N."""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

here = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.chdir(here)
if not os.path.isdir("node_modules"):
    lock = os.path.exists("package-lock.json")
    subprocess.run(["npm", "ci" if lock else "install", "--include=dev", "--no-audit", "--no-fund"], check=False, timeout=1500)
cmd = ["npx", "jest", "--ci", "__tests__/acceptance"]
m = os.environ.get("ACCEPTANCE_MILESTONE", "")
if m.isdigit():
    cmd += ["-t", "^(" + "|".join("M%d" % i for i in range(1, int(m) + 1)) + "): "]
# The app's own test script may add node flags (e.g. --experimental-vm-modules): use the same ones.
try:
    script = json.load(open("package.json")).get("scripts", {}).get("test", "")
except (OSError, ValueError):
    script = ""
env = dict(os.environ)
if "--experimental-vm-modules" in script:
    env["NODE_OPTIONS"] = (env.get("NODE_OPTIONS", "") + " --experimental-vm-modules").strip()
print("Running: " + " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
sys.exit(subprocess.run(cmd, env=env, timeout=1500).returncode)
